description: This file defines a helper base class for Blazor components, providing a standard refresh mechanism via event subscription and StateHasChanged invocation.

classes.name: BlazorComponent
classes.description: A base class for Blazor components that provides a refresh capability integrated with a broadcast system.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Sets up event subscription for refresh requests upon component initialization.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Method to trigger a refresh request via broadcast.

methods.name: DoRefresh
methods.description: Event handler called when a refresh is requested; calls StateHasChanged to re-render the component.
